name: 02. Multi-Step Interactive Feature Building
description: Demonstrates sequential multi-turn prompts with per-step file state outcome checks.

prompts.prompt: Create a new file `src/user.ts` exporting a `User` interface with `id: number`, `name: string`, and `email: string`.
Now update `src/user.ts` to export a function `isValidEmail(email: string): boolean` that checks if the string contains '@'.
